استذهنت (form X)
# اِسْتَذْهَنْتُ (istaḏhantu) /is.tað.han.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَذْهَنَ (istaḏhana)
# اِسْتَذْهَنْتَ (istaḏhanta) /is.tað.han.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَذْهَنَ (istaḏhana)
# اِسْتَذْهَنْتِ (istaḏhanti) /is.tað.han.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَذْهَنَ (istaḏhana)
# اِسْتَذْهَنَتْ (istaḏhanat) /is.t
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
